# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

##   CodeAnt Nitpicks
14 code suggestions #### 1. When the remaining retry time is shorter than the back-off, this sleeps to the deadline and the loop still starts another POST after it. Logic error · [`demo_only/burst.py:91`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-ba4a7abf5945ed4200954ca64822a65596e5e69df308037156b10265d8ade09fR91-R91) --- #### 2. `--n 0` is accepted as an integer, but `Barrier(0)` raises `ValueError` and prevents the command from returning a result. Logic error · [`demo_only/burst.py:114`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-ba4a7abf5945ed4200954ca64822a65596e5e69df308037156b10265d8ade09fR114-R114) --- #### 3. `ThreadingHTTPServer` handles this search alongside creates and deletes, so a concurrent change can raise `RuntimeError` while the dictionary is being iterated. Race condition · [`demo_only/fake_hubspot.py:247`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-aa097fae8c52d1bbdfd59b0fa68e05d14e0ce42e367640f13f561c2d387dfee1R247-R247) --- #### 4. Concurrent creates can both pass this check before either increments `failed`, causing more than the configured number of 429 or 503 responses. Race condition · [`demo_only/fake_hubspot.py:267-268`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-aa097fae8c52d1bbdfd59b0fa68e05d14e0ce42e367640f13f561c2d387dfee1R267-R268) --- #### 5. Concurrent creates with different emails can both see `hung_once` as false, so more than the first create hangs. Race condition · [`demo_only/fake_hubspot.py:279-280`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-aa097fae8c52d1bbdfd59b0fa68e05d14e0ce42e367640f13f561c2d387dfee1R279-R280) --- #### 6. `{"mode":[]}` is valid JSON but makes `ALIASES.get` raise `TypeError`; the uncaught error aborts requests instead of falling back to `state.mode`. Type error · [`demo_only/fake_model_server.py:72-75`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-589a0a9706b758eb1e50f61f37f368a08d596040c60d7b5b2a4f135e7684e852R72-R75) --- #### 7. `slow_seconds` and `hang_seconds` are stored without type checks; a string returns 200 from control, then `Event.wait` raises `TypeError` and drops requests. Type error · [`demo_only/fake_model_server.py:134-140`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-589a0a9706b758eb1e50f61f37f368a08d596040c60d7b5b2a4f135e7684e852R134-R140) --- #### 8. The first call has `call_no == 1`, so this index returns `warm`; mixed mode therefore does not begin with the documented `hot` label. Off-by-one · [`demo_only/fake_model_server.py:192-194`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-589a0a9706b758eb1e50f61f37f368a08d596040c60d7b5b2a4f135e7684e852R192-R194) --- #### 9. Because the delay runs before `_fail` is consumed, a send already sleeping can take a later `fail_next` setting instead of the next send. Race condition · [`demo_only/fakes.py:82-85`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-e9f53ffe9360512bca3ec05b94fe4ad739ef8842f15e90b3a2785f51bbf31871R82-R85) --- #### 10. `_fire` can return string statuses such as `timeout` or `refused`; this numeric comparison treats them as false, so the summary omits failed burst slots. Api mismatch · [`demo_only/portal_demo.js:126`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-29b5dce4bf832b8c0ee0e5055e9688a8fe3724f212858704d9f1c9e150fa6f7bR126-R126) --- #### 11. This value is captured only on mount; if a restart changes stop-test availability, subsequent demo updates leave the buttons enabled or disabled according to the old desk. Stale reference · [`demo_only/portal_demo.js:191`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-29b5dce4bf832b8c0ee0e5055e9688a8fe3724f212858704d9f1c9e150fa6f7bR191-R191) --- #### 12. If either follow-up poll request rejects during an outage, this chain never clears `dblBusy`; reconnecting leaves the test button disabled until the panel is remounted. Possible bug · [`demo_only/portal_demo.js:278`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-29b5dce4bf832b8c0ee0e5055e9688a8fe3724f212858704d9f1c9e150fa6f7bR278-R278) --- #### 13. With an older fakes server that omits `reminders` but already stores reminder emails, this fallback counts reminders as follow-ups and makes the proof report a false mismatch. Logic error · [`demo_only/portal_demo.py:333`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-c8e194d49aa63663f94fc100e84360962117c51a85de57638a06e75a17aee465R333-R333) --- #### 14. `step` and `step_label` indicate an active lead flow, but empty `steps` contradicts the response contract and leaves the portal without later-stage choices. Api mismatch · [`tests/portal_fixtures/lead-detail-later.json:83`](https://github.com/hadavin-dx/duplicate-proof-lead-desk-n8n/pull/3/files#diff-18ea96eebf9982289cab0694f358ff07411f7aadfb619ea1a8cdb3a8b07a9cccR83-R83)

For those requiring US-based hosting, [SonarQube Cloud US](https://sonarqube.us/) offers the perfect alternative. If you need data residency outside the US or within the EU, [SonarQube Cloud](https://sonarcloud.io/) with this GitHub app is the ideal solution.

SonarQube Cloud integrates seamlessly into your GitHub workflow and provides clear guidance for resolving any code quality and security issues detected. The majority of popular languages can be analyzed automatically; no configuration is required!
